description: Two storey front extension incorporating front porch; single and two storey side extensions; roof alterations to garage; air source heat pump to side; patio with steps to garden and balustrade; replacement timber posts and gates; landscaping; external alterations
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;Arboricultural Impact Assessment Rev D; ASW/JS/004/28/2024; fj/1467/P; GHA/DS/162240:26; PA2336; Planning &amp; Heritage Statement; Tree Constraints Plan; Tree Protection Plan Rev C; 1467/P/1; 1467/P/2; 1467/P/3; 1467/P/4; 1467/P/5; 1467/P/6L; 1467/P/7.

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the commencement of works hereby permitted, details of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces noted below have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority: (a) the extension/building(s) (b) the ground surfacing (c) the boundary treatment The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved details and plans and prior to the commencement of works hereby approved, the following details&nbsp; shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority:</p><p><br></p><p>a)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>A tree protection plan (which must include details of protection for the London Plane tree at the entrance to the site)</p><p>b)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>An Updated Tree report to include protection of the London Plane on the corner of the entrance of the site</p><p>c)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>A method statement for the existing retained trees</p><p>The approved details shall be implemented in full and maintained for the duration of the construction works.</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not commence until there has been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority, a scheme of hard and soft landscape works which shall include a survey of all existing trees and hedgerows on the land, indicating those to be retained and those to be lost. Details of those to be retained, together with measures for their protection in the course of the development, shall also be submitted and approved, and carried out in accordance with such approval, prior to any demolition or any other site works, and retained until the development is completed. Soft landscape works shall include: planting plans, and schedule of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities.</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of construction, a scale, colour plan of biodiversity enhancements on the site, to include the number, specification, and location of enhancements such as bat boxes, bird boxes, insect shelters, and hedgehog highways, as well as evidence of the removal of invasive species and a native planting regime, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Thereafter, the biodiversity enhancement measures shall be carried out and retained in accordance with the approved details.</p>

<p>All site clearance (including the removal of any vegetation or works to areas sensitive) shall be timed so as to avoid the bird nesting season, this being during the months of March until September inclusive, unless the Local Planning Authority has confirmed in writing that such works can proceed, based on submission of a survey (no more than 48hrs before works commence) undertaken by a suitably qualified ecologist to assess the nesting bird activity on site, together with details of measures to protect the nesting bird interest on the site as required.</p>

<p>No external lighting shall be installed on the dwelling hereby permitted unless full details of a lighting scheme are submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall include details of the exact location, height, design, and intensity of the lights, and shall be designed to prevent light spillage onto nearby habitat suitable for bats. The lighting shall be installed and operated strictly in accordance with the approved details.</p>
